module.title: Object Storage, Medical Media and PACS Catalog
module.business_purpose: Stores large immutable or versioned binaries: DICOM, reports, PDFs, videos, signed evidence, exports, backups and raw payloads. The database stores metadata, hashes, retention, encryption, legal hold and object locations; binary content remains in object storage/PACS.
